blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—University of Santo Tomas used a blistering third quarter to defeat Ateneo, 80-68, in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament at UST Quadricentennial Pavilion on Saturday. After a neck-and-neck first half where the Growling Tigers barely led the Blue Eagles, 34-32, they shifted into a whole other gear in the third frame en route to back-to-back wins. “It was very special to play in this school and in our home court,” UST assistant coach Japs Cuan said. “As early as practice, we already saw the line outside and it inspired […]...
